about: The router sends a history question to the history tutor, who looks up two things on Wikipedia (the printing press and the telescope) before answering. Both run on Groq, free tier.
how: The router answers with JSON: the chosen specialist and a reason. The history tutor asks for Wikipedia twice; each call returns the title, a summary and the address of the page, and the model answers from them.
learns: A router can choose wrongly when a question fits two specialists. The history specialist can call a tool: here a Wikipedia lookup, so its facts do not come from memory alone.
watch: Whether the router picks the history tutor, the two Wikipedia rows (what was searched, what came back) and how the answer follows the pages.
